what_is_absent: A supported country for Shopify Payments other than the 40 that the supported countries page lists (Australia to the United States, as Shopify Payments for <country> pages). The page states what applies to a business located in a country that isn't listed: then you need to use a third-party payment provider.
note: Statement S01-SH-096 holds the list in full; S01-SH-095 holds the sentence that presents it as the supported countries.

what_is_absent: A Shopify affiliate acting as Payment Facilitator in any Designated Country outside the two regions that Part II of the Payment Facilitator Terms lists (A. EU / EEA; B. United Kingdom).
note: The completeness words are in the Shopify Payments Terms of Service (Part I, A): the Designated Countries where a Shopify affiliate acts as a Payment Facilitator are listed in the Payment Facilitator Terms.
